title: Zoey's Survival Modpack
description: Make Minecraft look more modern and immersive without heavily changing the core gameplay experience.
body:
Have you ever wanted a lightweight Minecraft modpack that improves the game’s visuals while keeping the original vanilla feeling intact?

Then take a look at this pack.

This modpack enhances the overall Minecraft experience with:

* Improved graphics and visual effects
* Carefully selected shaders and resource packs
* Better lighting, atmosphere, and immersion
* Support for long-distance terrain rendering with Distant Horizons
* Included quality-of-life features like:
    * Xaero’s Minimap
    * Simple Voice Chat
    * WorldEdit for creative builders

The goal of this modpack is to make Minecraft look more modern and immersive without heavily changing the core gameplay experience.

## Troubleshooting

If the modpack does not start because of a conflict between Distant Horizons and Iris Shaders, you can fix it by editing the following line inside:

_config/DistantHorizons.toml_

Change:

```
renderingApi = "AUTO"
```
To:
```
renderingApi = "OPEN_GL"
```

Alternatively, you can disable either:

* Distant Horizons
* Iris Shaders

Neither of these mods is required for the modpack to work properly.
